core-worlds.name: Core Worlds
core-worlds.text: Dense Fleet and civic infrastructure, mature standards systems, high-bandwidth records, and institutions accustomed to reliable interoperability. Fleet visual grammar is blue, gold, and white, but working technical spaces are restrained rather than ceremonial.

lattice-margin.name: Lattice Margin
lattice-margin.text: Broken-geometry space at the edge of mapped corridors where signal paths, timing references, and sensor assumptions can become unreliable. The environment is scientifically observable but not fully understood; do not render supernatural symbols or fantasy effects.

verge.name: The Verge
verge.text: Frontier systems dependent on corridor reliability, field repair, trade, and survey work. Civil infrastructure is practical, patched, and locally adapted. Green is culturally associated with safe routes and ordinary people who depend on them.
